mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stocks (user_id, symbol, company_name, quantity, avg_cost, currency) VALUES (#{userId}, #{symbol}, #{companyName}, #{quantity}, #{avgCost}, #{currency})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stocks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, symbol, company_name, quantity, avg_cost, currency, created_at FROM stocks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY symbol ASC
